howto.name: Pick a unit
howto.text: Choose Paragraphs (the default), Sentences or Words. Each sentence has 6 to 17 random words, a capital first letter and a full stop, and each paragraph has 3 to 6 sentences. Words mode gives a plain run of words with no capitals added and no punctuation.

howto.name: Set the count
howto.text: Enter how many paragraphs, sentences or words you want, from 1 to 100; it starts at 5. A number above 100 is lowered to 100, and 0 or an empty box becomes 1.

howto.name: Choose a word list
howto.text: Lorem, the default, uses 63 words taken from the classic Lorem Ipsum passage. Cyberpunk, Pirate and Hacker swap in themed English word lists. Words are drawn at random and can repeat, even side by side.

howto.name: Keep or drop the opener
howto.text: In Paragraphs mode, the Start with box (ticked by default) replaces the first word of the first paragraph with the list's opener: Lorem ipsum, Neon rain, Yarr matey or Wake up. The rest of that sentence stays random. Sentences and Words modes never add the opener.

howto.name: Reroll and copy
howto.text: Changing any option generates new text, and Reroll makes a fresh version with the same settings. Copy takes the whole output: paragraphs are separated by a blank line, while sentences and words come out as one block.

faq.q: What does the output look like?
faq.a: Words mode with a count of 5 gives something like anim commodo laboris lorem ipsum: five words, no capitals and no full stop. In Paragraphs mode with the opener on, a first random sentence such as 'Tempor sit amet dolore magna enim.' becomes 'Lorem ipsum sit amet dolore magna enim.', and the paragraph continues with 2 to 5 more sentences.

faq.q: Does it start with the full 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' sentence?
faq.a: No. Only the two opening words are fixed. The generator does not reproduce the standard passage in order; it strings random words from the list, so you get Lorem ipsum followed by shuffled Latin-looking words.

faq.q: Why use Lorem Ipsum and not English?
faq.a: Placeholder text shows how a layout handles real word lengths, line breaks and paragraph sizes without inviting reviewers to read and edit the words. Latin-looking text is hard to read as content, which keeps attention on the design.

No. Besides the classic Latin-style list there are three themed English lists: Cyberpunk, Pirate and Hacker, which open with Neon rain, Yarr matey and Wake up. There is no option for other languages, other scripts or your own word list.

The classic list comes from Lorem Ipsum, a scrambled extract of Cicero's De finibus bonorum et malorum, a classical Latin text in the public domain. The generator only strings single words together at random.

faq.q: Does it call an API or use secure randomness?
faq.a: Neither. The text is generated by JavaScript on this page with Math.random, and the tool makes no network request. Math.random suits filler text but is not a cryptographic generator, so use a dedicated password or UUID generator when randomness matters.

faq.q: How much text can one run produce?
faq.a: Up to 100 of the chosen unit: 100 paragraphs, 100 sentences or 100 words. For more, copy the output, press Reroll and copy again.
